title: Liberty Garden Single Arm Navigator Hose Reel 732, Matte Black

comparisons.notes: Liberty Garden 732 Single Arm Pull Up Latch Navigator 360 Rotating Hose Reel, Matte Black, same model 732-B (UPC 764736007329). Fulfilled by Walmart, in stock.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN from Woot feed, confirmed exact match (model 732-B, UPC 764736007329) by the price checker.
writeup: Liberty Garden's 732 Navigator is a single-arm wall hose reel in matte black with a pull-up latch that swivels a full 360 degrees and holds up to 125 feet of 5/8-inch hose. Woot has it new for $89.99, while Walmart sells the same model for $219.99, so you save about $130. Woot caps it at 3 per customer.
